reason: After reviewing the Ciena Corporation 10-K filing for fiscal year 2025 (ending November 1, 2025), no Total Addressable Market (TAM) figures were found disclosed by the company. The filing contains extensive financial data, segment revenue breakdowns (Networking Platforms, Platform Software and Services, Blue Planet Automation Software and Services, and Global Services), geographic revenue splits (Americas, EMEA, Asia Pacific), and customer concentration information. However, the company did not publish any TAM estimates, market size figures, or addressable market assessments in this filing. The document focuses on historical financial performance, product categories, customer relationships (notably AT&T and cloud providers), and operational metrics, but does not include forward-looking market opportunity quantification that would constitute a company-disclosed TAM.
